headline: Public hearings on zoning text amendments for Boynton Yards, affordable dwelling units, Zoning Board of Appeals rules, and backyard cottages.
summary: The agenda lists five public hearings on requests to amend the zoning text. The requests cover Boynton Yards, affordable dwelling units, Zoning Board of Appeals rules, and backyard cottages.
items: Public hearing on Boynton Yards LandCo LLC and Windsor Place Owner LLC request to amend section 8.4.12.e.ii (ID # 26-1480)
Public hearing on 36 registered voters' request to amend Zoning Ordinance Section 12.1.2 regarding affordable dwelling units (ID # 26-1512)
Public hearing on 36 registered voters' request to amend Zoning Ordinance Section 15.7.2.d, Zoning Board of Appeals Board Rules (ID # 26-1511)
Public hearing on 36 registered voters' request to amend Zoning Ordinance Section 3.1.12, Backyard Cottage (ID # 26-1510)
Public hearing on 36 registered voters' request to amend Zoning Ordinance Section 3.1.12, Backyard Cottage (ID # 26-1509)
